notes.title: [Event]August Summer Vacation Event
notes.content:
[b]Hello, heroes of Lodoss Islands.[/b]

Here are the details for our August Summer Vacation Event.


1. Attendance Check

[Duration]
July 18th After Maintenance ~ August 12th 11:59PM(UTC)

[Details]
Everyone connecting to Lodoss War Online can receive the items listed below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34122155/a76a34bd3621f052ca8841da29060139000052eb.jpg[/img]

※ Please note
1.Attendance check is limited to once per account.
2.Event rewards can be collected by the accumulated number of attendance.
3.Attendance check event rewards can be collected by clicking Aris’s Report from bottom menu > Attendance check
4.Event items have different tradable status. Please check the item tooltip for more information. 
5.Event items will not be transferred or recovered if the item was received by the wrong character.
6.Item details can be checked in game, from item tooltip. (Place the cursor over in-game item and press '+' key)
7. Event details could be changed due to internal affairs. If any changes are made we will notify about it in a separate announcement


2. Summer Vacation Ticket Event

[Duration]
July 18th After Maintenance ~ August 13th Before Maintenance

[Details]

How to participate in event

- Special monster “Heat wave shadow” appears certain chance when you eliminate monsters with -20, +10 level of your character.
- Eliminating “Heat wave shadow” provides 10 times the original monster’s EXP, and provides “Summer Vacation Ticket” token.
- “Heat wave shadow” does not appear in Exploration Dungeons, Labyrinths, and Raids.

How to exchange Summer Vacation Ticket

- Summer Vacation Ticket Tokens can be exchanged with various items from Jackson Town Event Helper NPC “Nell”
- The items available for exchange are listed below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34122155/ee0c4397beb4ab4c24c318152747d60492c36333.jpg[/img]

You can obtain 1 random item from the list below in Summer Vacation Supply Box.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34122155/fc0a96e911df310d4cc1b85b140b19b56c21b930.jpg[/img]

※ Please note
1. Event items have different tradable status. Please check the item tooltip for more information. Event items will not be transferred or recovered if the item was received by the wrong character.
2. Each item effect can be checked in game, from item tooltip. (Place the cursor over in-game item and press '-' key)
3. Event details could be changed due to internal affairs. If any changes are made we will notify about it in a separate announcement


3. Chatting Buff Event

[Duration]
July 18th After Maintenance ~ August 13th Before Maintenance

[Details]
- Type in “Summer Vacation” in chat to receive the buff below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34122155/ac774b0e0d7cbc44be9d11f1287cf975f6df4f71.jpg[/img]

※ Please note
1. Event details could be changed due to internal affairs. If any changes are made we will notify about it in a separate announcement


4. Adventurer Association Special Event

[Duration]
To be notified when event ends

[Details]
All monsters’ HP is reduced by 20%
Daily Association Mission Achievement Reward is improved

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34122155/16e9f146cf05c7f109ffed0d6d7418c059bd5f50.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34122155/16e9f146cf05c7f109ffed0d6d7418c059bd5f50.jpg[/img]
